prompt: Write acceptance criteria for this multi-step onboarding flow: Only workspace owners can start onboarding from the Setup banner. Step 1 (Workspace details): the owner enters a workspace name and clicks Continue; while saving, the button shows "Saving..."; if the name is blank, the page shows "Enter a workspace name." Step 2 (Invite team): the owner adds teammate emails or clicks Skip to reach the Dashboard. After a page reload on Step 2, the saved workspace name stays stored and the owner remains on Step 2. Billing setup is out of scope.
output:
## Acceptance criteria: Multi-step onboarding flow

Requirement: Workspace owners start a multi-step onboarding flow from the Setup banner to save a workspace name on Step 1 (Workspace details) and add teammate emails or skip on Step 2 (Invite team) to reach the Dashboard, with Step 2 progress preserved after a page reload and billing setup out of scope.

### Main path
AC-1. Given the owner has entered a workspace name on Step 1 (Workspace details), when the owner clicks Continue, then Step 2 (Invite team) is shown. _Step 1 (Workspace details): the owner enters a workspace name and clicks Continue_
AC-2. Given the owner is on Step 2 (Invite team), when the owner adds teammate emails, then the Dashboard is shown. _Step 2 (Invite team): the owner adds teammate emails_
AC-3. Given the owner is on Step 2 (Invite team), when the owner clicks Skip, then the Dashboard is shown. _clicks Skip to reach the Dashboard._

### Validation and errors
AC-4. Given the owner is on Step 1 (Workspace details) with a blank workspace name, when the owner clicks Continue, then the message "Enter a workspace name." is shown on the page. _if the name is blank, the page shows "Enter a workspace name."_

### Permissions and roles
AC-5. Given a workspace owner viewing the Setup banner, when the owner starts onboarding, then Step 1 (Workspace details) is shown. _Only workspace owners can start onboarding from the Setup banner._

### Empty, loading and disabled states
AC-6. Given the owner has clicked Continue on Step 1 (Workspace details), when the workspace name is saving, then the Continue button shows "Saving...". _while saving, the button shows "Saving..."_

### Persistence after reload
AC-7. Given the owner is on Step 2 (Invite team) with a saved workspace name, when the page is reloaded, then the saved workspace name stays stored. _After a page reload on Step 2, the saved workspace name stays stored_
AC-8. Given the owner is on Step 2 (Invite team), when the page is reloaded, then the owner remains on Step 2 (Invite team). _the owner remains on Step 2._

### Flow & State Table
| Step | User does | System shows (loading / empty / error / success) | Next or exit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Step 1 (Workspace details) | Enters a workspace name and clicks Continue | Loading: button shows "Saving..."; Error: blank name shows "Enter a workspace name."; Empty / save error: TBD (see Open questions); Success: advances to Step 2 (Invite team) | Step 2 (Invite team) |
| Step 2 (Invite team) | Adds teammate emails or clicks Skip | Loading / empty / error: TBD (see Open questions); Success: reaches Dashboard | Dashboard |

Entry point: Workspace owners start onboarding from the Setup banner.
Exit: Dashboard, reached after adding teammate emails or clicking Skip on Step 2 (Invite team).
Reload: After a page reload on Step 2 (Invite team), the saved workspace name stays stored and the owner remains on Step 2 (Invite team); reload on Step 1 (Workspace details): TBD (see Open questions).
Permissions: Only workspace owners can start onboarding from the Setup banner; non-owner behaviour: TBD (see Open questions).

### Open questions
- [blocking] Main path: What control or action submits added teammate emails on the Invite team step to reach the Dashboard? Blocks: AC-2
- [blocking] Permissions and roles: What observable result occurs when a user who is not a workspace owner views the Setup banner or tries to start onboarding? Blocks: "Only workspace owners can start onboarding from the Setup banner."
- [blocking] Persistence after reload: Where is the saved workspace name displayed after a page reload so persistence can be verified? Blocks: AC-7
- [minor] Validation and errors: What happens when an invalid teammate email is entered on the Invite team step? Empty, loading and disabled states: What is the state of the Continue button while it shows "Saving..."?
- [minor] Empty, loading and disabled states: What is shown on the Invite team step while saving or before teammate emails are added? Persistence after reload: What happens after a page reload on the Workspace details step?

### Out of scope
- Billing setup. _Billing setup is out of scope._
